name: CA-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: D+13 district with a well-funded, long-tenured incumbent
Challenger shows no reported fundraising or campaign infrastructure
Prediction markets price Huffman near-certain at about 96%
No polls or expert ratings; fundamentals carry the forecast
model.rationale: Huffman's incumbency, the district's thirteen-point Democratic lean, and a complete fundraising asymmetry leave the Republican challenger without a visible path; prediction markets and district fundamentals both point to a comfortable Huffman win.
model.watch: Only an unexpected scandal or dramatic late development would put this seat in play.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
California's second district runs along the North Coast from the Golden Gate to the Oregon border and leans Democratic by about thirteen points. Jared Huffman has held the seat since 2013 and enters the general election with more than a million dollars on hand after advancing through the top-two primary. His Republican opponent, Robin Littau, shows no reported fundraising or outside spending.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, the incumbent's financial advantage, and prediction markets, which price Huffman's chances around ninety-six percent. Past cycles have produced double-digit Huffman victories, and nothing in the current evidence suggests a different environment. The seat is rated Safe for Democrats, with the main uncertainty being turnout variation rather than a genuine competitive threat.
